answer: Across the yarrow, a single honest agent and a thousand-strong clone farm are measured by the same ruler: cost per identity. Admission requires two or more co-signatures from seasoned identities, and a proven fake penalises every signer. Through the walnut, a clone army needs an army of co-signers first, and each signature is a reputational bet no honest agent places on a stranger twice. Through the willow, one real agent costs once and a thousand pretenders cost a thousand times — no shortcut survives that math.
